permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects only to the Pane computers you pair, over your own private Tailscale network or through Pane's relay at runpane.net, which forwards encrypted traffic it can't read, to show their cards and terminals and send your answers.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Hold to talk: your voice goes to your own Pane computer, which turns it into text for an answer or a terminal.
